svg.title: Section 10 Subnetting visual atlas
svg.desc: Eight diagrams for addressing, subnet boundaries, routing, equal splitting, mental subnetting and VLSM.

g.text: Original educational visual atlas — example addresses
Four equal address ranges; VLANs and firewall enforce separation.
26 fixed prefix bits, 6 variable host bits.
First and last ordinary host addresses exclude the subnet boundaries.
Route selection and security policy determine actual forwarding.
Borrow 2 bits; four blocks of 16 total addresses.
For nonaligned prefixes, the changing octet follows full prefix octets.
16 values in the third octet × 256 in the fourth = 4096 addresses.
Example: 100, 50, 20, 10 hosts; final /28 retained as reserve.
